blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Tenpin Bowling Association (CETBA) successfully staged one of its major tournaments of the year, the CETBA–RICH Banana Catsup Bowling Cup, over the weekend at the SM City Cebu Bowling Center, bringing together bowlers from three Cebu bowling associations ahead of next month’s National Bowling Tour (NBT) championships.
